messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate detected for /generate (prod). Alert: prod-alert-high-error-rate triggered at 03:14 UTC. Paging mona-sre (primary), eliot-oncall (on-call).

mona-sre: on it. looking at rates now — seeing a 6x increase in 5xx and some 4xx spikes.

eliot-oncall: ack. are errors 500s from runtime or 502s from upstream? any client error pattern?

mona-sre: initial split looks like ~60% 502/504, 30% 500, rest 4xx. stack traces are thin — we might be missing request_kv in logs. logs show many truncated entries.

devon-eng: skipping full triage for now — can we get a quick timeline and scope? customers impacted?

sabrina-cs: CSMs reporting multiple customers with timeouts in dashboards and some support tickets. Not widespread yet but 3 paying customers flagged.

mona-sre: quick scope: traffic drop on /generate for eu-west region, request success rate down from 99.8% -> 92% since 03:10. Errors concentrated on the ml-serving cluster group-2.

logs-bot: Attached link to raw logs: https://logs.redwood.example/prod/search?q=%2Fgenerate&from=03%3A00&to=03%3A20

eliot-oncall: thanks. can someone paste the query they're running? I'll run traces and check KV cache stats.

devon-eng: here's a useful ad-hoc query (ELASTIC):
```
GET /_search
{
  "query": {
    "bool": {
      "filter": [
        {"term": {"path": "/generate"}},
        {"range": {"@timestamp": {"gte": "2026-03-15T03:00:00Z", "lte": "2026-03-15T03:20:00Z"}}}
      ]
    }
  },
  "aggs": {"by_status": {"terms": {"field": "status"}}}
}
```

devon-eng: paste results: 502: 4200, 504: 1300, 500: 2100, 429: 300 (approx).

mona-sre: interesting — 429s too. could be a cascade from a degrading backend causing retries and throttling. but first observability gap: many log lines lack request_id and kv payload since ~00:45. sampling config change?

kei-frontend: we pushed a logging-sampling change earlier today that targeted /health and high-volume routes. didn't touch /generate. but I'll re-check the PR.

mona-sre: filing hypothesis list in-thread so we don't lose context: 1) model-serving cluster started dropping connections -> 502/504. 2) logging agent sampling accidentally changed set -> missing request_kv fields, hindering root-cause. 3) downstream rate-limiter triggered due to retries -> 429s. 4) recent deployment to group-2 introduced regression.

eliot-oncall: good. mitigation proposal now: (A) enable conservative fallback routing to group-1 for a subset of traffic; (B) temporarily increase logging sampling for /generate for 15m to get full payloads; (C) add a short retry/backoff tweak at edge. which is low-risk?

devon-eng: (A) is doable and low-risk — can shift 10% traffic to group-1 via runtime routing config. (B) requires logging sidecar change and may increase costs but will give necessary trace data. (C) small config change on gateway — can do rapid rollout with canary.

mona-sre: do (A) and (B) now. I'll run timeline extraction and start correlating node-level errors.

kei-frontend: re: PR — I found it. sampling override was intended for /stream endpoints but a glob pattern mistakenly matched /generate. PR 8123 changed sampling from 100% -> 10% for routes matching "/st*". our glob matched because of a joined config string. rolling that back now.

logs-bot: Sampling correction deployed to logging agent at 03:22 UTC (rollback of PR 8123). Note: older logs remain sampled; new logs should include request_kv going forward.

mona-sre: timeline (building):
- 00:41 UTC: PR 8123 merged (sampling change).
- 00:45 UTC: first signs of truncated logs (missing request_kv).
- 03:10 UTC: error rate spike begins, manifested as 502/504 on group-2.
- 03:14 UTC: alert fired and pager.
- 03:22 UTC: sampling rollback deployed.
- 03:26 UTC: apply routing tweak to shift 10% traffic to group-1.

devon-eng: timeline looks consistent. we should get richer logs now to see if requests that errored have large input sizes or specific payload patterns.

eliot-oncall: i've applied routing to shift 10% to group-1, monitoring SLOs. initial metrics show success rate on canary traffic is 99.6%.

sabrina-cs: letting impacted customers know: temporary mitigation applied, currently assessing impact window. Will update Affected list with timestamps.

mona-sre: ad-hoc query to pull enriched lines after rollback (copy/paste into logs UI):
```
source: prod-logs
query: path:"/generate" AND @timestamp:["2026-03-15T03:20:00Z" TO "2026-03-15T03:30:00Z"]
fields: [request_id, status, node, model_variant, request_kv.size, latency_ms]
```

mona-sre: attaching few sample enriched lines: 
`request_id=abcd123 status=502 node=node-7 model_variant=v2 request_kv.size=1241 latency_ms=412`
`request_id=efgh456 status=504 node=node-12 model_variant=v2 request_kv.size=534 latency_ms=820`

devon-eng: based on request_kv.size distribution, errors skew to larger payloads >1k tokens. that suggests model runtime OOM/timeout path. checking model logs for v2 on group-2.

kei-frontend: confirm — the glob misconfig caused most of /generate sampling to be at 10% between 00:45-03:22, so our early debugging missed the payload-size correlation. good catch.

devon-eng: pulled model runtime logs, seeing GC spikes and some worker restarts on node-7 and node-12 around 03:08-03:12. corresponds with increased latencies before 502s. hypothesis strengthened: model runtime struggling on large requests leading to connection drops.

mona-sre: hypothesis ranking: 1) model runtime resource exhaustion for large payloads -> primary. 2) sampling misconfig obscured traces -> contributing observability gap. 3) cascading retries -> 429s secondary. 4) deployment regression less likely (no new model code in group-2 since last stable deploy).

eliot-oncall: next mitigation: throttle large payloads at edge for 10m and send 100% of large requests to group-1. set config to reject requests >1500 tokens with 429 and ask clients to retry with smaller inputs. patching gateway now.

sabrina-cs: drafting customer note: "We observed increased timeouts and error rates on /generate between 03:10-03:30 UTC. A mitigation was applied and logs indicate most failures were due to large request sizes. We recommend clients cap token sizes. We'll follow up with RCA." 

mona-sre: handoff plan: eliot-oncall — continue monitoring until success rate stable >99.5% for 30m. devon-eng — follow up on model runtime memory tuning and safe-guard to prevent worker restarts. kei-frontend — ensure sampling config is fixed and add a unit test to prevent globs matching /generate. sabrina-cs — update affected customer list and ticket backlog.

eliot-oncall: on it. I'll escalate to infra if we see restarts again. set a paging policy if error rate >3% in next hour.

devon-eng: i'll open a follow-up RFC for model-side circuit breaker + smaller-inference chunking and a postmortem action item to investigate memory footprint on v2.

mona-sre: quick post-incident note while fresh:
- Root cause (interim): model runtime exhaustion for large payloads, amplified by observability gap from accidental sampling config change.
- Immediate fixes: sampling rollback, traffic routing to group-1, edge throttling for large payloads.
- Action items: improve logging config testing, add canary for sampling changes, model runtime hardening, customer communication.

sabrina-cs: i'll send the customer note draft in #customer-notifications and tag legal for the segmented list.

logs-bot: Full enriched logs now available: https://logs.redwood.example/prod/search?from=03%3A20&to=03%3A40&enriched=true

mona-sre: last check: overall success rate back to 99.7% at 03:34 UTC. leaving oncall to monitor. thanks team — will regroup for RCA doc and long-form postmortem after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
